sample_unit: patients (plus 5 radiation oncologist raters; 6 questions across 5 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient-education responses measured by Flesch Reading Ease Index
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease Index indicated responses from all LLMs were relatively difficult to understand, although patients perceived ChatGPT-4 information as easy to understand.
links.quote: The Flesch Reading Ease Index indicated that the responses from all LLMs were relatively difficult to understand.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM-generated patient education responses on prostate cancer radiotherapy evaluated offline by clinicians and patients for accuracy, readability, and trustworthiness.
